blurb: Guests parasail from a 31-foot US Coast Guard certified boat over the Atlantic Ocean, enjoying panoramic views of New Jersey's beaches and coastline. Flights include options to stay dry, dip gently, or do a full water dunk. Photo and video packages are available to capture the experience.

quotes.text: Flying with Belmar Parasail was an incredible experience. The crew was professional, super friendly and made sure we felt safe the whole time. We used the GoPro and loved it. Their professional photos are also way better than you'd ever get using your iphone. If you want a thrilling adventure with stunning views, these guys are the best. Highly recommend.
